info.title: dsh-codex-runner Communication API
info.description: Communication between the plugin settings page and the DSH host, suitable for import into Apipost. This specification does not cover the 15 model tools such as codex_run and does not describe an independent HTTP server. The plugin and DSH Connection Fetch must be enabled. All operations require DSH owner access. Replace the example server with the actual DSH Web base URL, including the port and deployment prefix, and configure a valid owner session Cookie. Cookie names depend on the host address; this specification models the complete Cookie header and does not introduce a plugin API key. Do not substitute Codex login credentials for a DSH session. For business errors returned with HTTP 200, inspect result.ok and result.error. All examples are synthetic and contain no real credentials, accounts, or local paths.

post.summary: Read the model catalog and field reference
post.description:
Read all models, supported reasoning efforts and service tiers, registry data, and localization metadata. refresh=true requests a new query; an expired cache may also trigger a refresh. This may start a read-only CLI query and update caches, but does not start a model turn. The response is the service catalog structure, which differs from the reduced output of the codex_models tool. Example models illustrate the format and are not evidence of availability for the current account.

post.summary: Read account-wide quota and recovery state
post.description:
Return account-wide five-hour and seven-day quota windows, sample time, warning, probe, and recovery state. Quota is not allocated per workspace. fresh only queries the account API and does not start a model turn; refresh cannot bypass its three-minute rate limit. active reads active-run snapshots without sending messages. When no data is available, status=unknown; failed queries may retain older data.

post.description:
Read up to 32 saved subagent entries for a run in a workspace known to the plugin. If run ownership, records, or metadata are unavailable, the result has ok=true and value=null. This operation does not start subagents, read complete child messages, or cancel processes.

post.summary: Read the registry editor document and revision
post.description:
Read merged field rules, Chinese translations, generated metadata, the revision, and setting definitions. Configuration values remain managed by DSH configForms. refresh=true rediscovers fields and updates reference caches; it is not merely a refresh of an in-memory draft. When readOnly=true, revision=null and saving is unavailable. The response example omits fields and uses a placeholder revision; never use it to replace the actual document.

post.summary: Preview or save field rules and Chinese translations
post.description:
Call getEditorRegistry first, copy its complete document and revision, then edit the required fields. The example only illustrates the structure: the all-zero revision and empty fields are placeholders and cannot be used directly for saving. The example uses preview=true for validation only; preview=false writes field overrides and user Chinese translations to fixed locations, without saving current profile settings. Preserve codexVersion and updatedAt unchanged. Omitted bundled fields are treated as disabled; reread the document if the revision is stale. The implementation attempts rollback if writing the rule or translation files fails. Preview returns configuration and definitions; saving returns a new complete editor view. This operation does not call a translation model.

HTTP 200 only means the envelope was processed. Check result.ok; business failures appear in result.error and do not automatically become HTTP 400 or 409. Send a client-request envelope, not the payload alone.

requestBody.description: application/json; the complete body is limited to 1048576 JavaScript string code units. The serialized document is separately limited to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes. The host may impose additional request body limits

get.description: Requires host connection, webServer, rpc.handle, and runEventStream support; the route is not registered if these are unavailable. The connection first receives a comment, then terminal-state invalidation notifications as data: JSON frames. This is not full progress output or a model token stream and does not use a server-response envelope. Each run emits one terminal event. There is no history replay or guaranteed Last-Event-ID recovery. The connection may remain open without any data frames; use a streaming client, since ordinary HTTP tests may time out. Only runs registered in the current process are observed; this operation does not start tasks

200.description: Continuous Server-Sent Events; each data frame ends with two newline characters

DshOwnerSession.name: Cookie
DshOwnerSession.description: Provide the complete Cookie header value of an authenticated DSH owner session (name=value; ...). Names depend on the host address and must not be hardcoded. This only models HTTP session transport; DSH Connection performs signature verification and owner authorization. Configure the value in a private Apipost environment, not in shared documentation

RpcId.description: Lowercase UUID v4; rpcId correlates requests and is echoed unchanged in responses. runId uses the same format

message.description: Reason for a validation, read, or save failure

refresh.description: Request rediscovery or refresh; may update local reference caches without starting a model turn

probe.description: none reads existing data; fresh queries the account; active reads active-run snapshots; both combines the latter two without sending steer messages

refresh.description: Refresh flag; does not bypass the three-minute rate limit for fresh probes

NativeJsonSchema.description: Codex JSON Schema carried as data, not an OpenAPI Schema Object; may contain native extensions and recursive definitions

aliasOf.description: Target field key; must satisfy native safe-key rules

excludedValues.description: String values excluded from the native enum

FieldRule.description: Compatibility rule keyed by a validated Codex field name; aliases cannot bypass permission controls

TranslationText.description: Single-line plain text of at most 200 characters; no angle brackets, control characters, or line breaks

_source.description: Source metadata accepted for compatibility; not regenerated by manual saves

Translations.description: User Chinese translations; blank values inherit bundled text. Native IDs are preserved and no translation model is called automatically

codexVersion.description: System-generated; preserve the original value returned by getEditorRegistry when saving

updatedAt.description: System-generated time of the last successful refresh; preserve the original value when saving

fields.description: Complete merged field rules; do not replace the fetched result with an empty object

RegistryDocument.description: Read the current document first, edit only the required fields, and preserve all other content. Omitting a bundled field is treated as disabling it

revision.description: Use the revision SHA-256 returned by the latest getEditorRegistry call; stale revisions return a business error

preview.description: true validates only and does not write user rule or translation files; false commits the save

source.description: Registry source, such as bundled, cache, or installed-protocol

fields.description: Compiled field definitions, including dynamic schemas and compatibility metadata

config.description: Fields allowed for generic passthrough and their compiled configuration; values vary with the native version

fallbackFile.description: Relative path to the bundled fallback file

paths.description: Local file locations returned by the host; may contain machine-specific paths and should not be copied unchanged into public examples

FieldRegistry.description: Native fields and discovery metadata vary with the CLI version; additional fields are preserved

nativeKey.description: Corresponding native key; null for plugin-owned settings

defaultValue.description: Default JSON value of the setting, which may be null

revision.description: Revision SHA-256 when editable; null when read-only

readOnly.description: true when user files are corrupt or unreadable

definitions.description: Current plugin configuration field definitions, excluding actual setting values in the current profile

RegistryPreviewView.description: Response for preview=true; does not contain a new document, revision, or readOnly flag

multiAgentVersion.description: Native subagent capability version; null when not provided

source.description: app-server, fallback, or the source retained in the cache

error.description: Refresh failure diagnostic; usually omitted on success

settings.description: Localized registry setting descriptions, not current profile configuration

accountFingerprint.description: Account fingerprint; not a login credential

resets_at.description: Quota reset time; null when unknown

reset_in_sec.description: Seconds until reset, relative to this response

RecoveryState.description: Recovery state for the original run. May include phase, run_id, generation, resume_at, schedule_id, resumed_run_id, error, and retention_warning; null when no record exists

next_probe_at.description: Next time a fresh probe is permitted

SubagentsView.description: The value is null when run ownership, records, or metadata cannot be found

status.description: Terminal status of this run, such as completed, failed, or cancelled

InvalidRequest.description: Plugin envelope or JSON validation failed; plain text rather than result.error

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the plugin's string-length limit; the host may reject it earlier

Unauthenticated.description: DSH host authentication failed; returned by the host, with a deployment-dependent body format

Forbidden.description: The connected peer is not an owner; DSH Connection denies access

NotFound.description: The plugin is disabled, the route is unregistered, a host service is missing, or the URL or HTTP method does not match

HostError.description: Other responses from the host, a proxy, or an uncaught exception; status and format depend on the deployment
